change.name: tail2/tail4 shortcut before bounded slow path
change.summary: Probe last.prevIn, last.prevIn.prevIn, and last.prevIn.prevIn.prevIn before delegating to the slow path. Tail2 and tail4 hits move the found edge after the tracking cursor.

verdict.reason: Tail2/tail4 hit-rate is below 0.3% of reads in pathological scenarios and does not materially reduce slowPath. The extra pointer checks appear to tax common paths more than they help oscillation cases.
verdict.nextStep: Discard code changes. If probing continues, test lastSlowEdge cache or a consumer-local adaptive mode instead.
